cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
project(CppChecks CXX)
enable_testing()
set(INSTALL_GTEST OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
if(LIGHTPAD_GTEST_SOURCE_DIR)
  add_subdirectory("${LIGHTPAD_GTEST_SOURCE_DIR}" googletest)
else()
  find_package(GTest REQUIRED)
endif()
add_executable(cpp_tests test_math.cpp)
target_link_libraries(cpp_tests PRIVATE GTest::gtest_main)
include(GoogleTest)
gtest_discover_tests(cpp_tests)
